description.value:
The following weapon modifications are catalogued alphabetically; any listed prerequisite must already be met when you install one.

  • Accuracy Focus (requires 5th level and a Blaster): +1 to attack rolls with the weapon, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Amplifying Barrel (requires 5th level and a Blaster): +1 to damage rolls with the weapon, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Bayonet (requires a Blaster): a short blade fixed to the barrel lets you make a melee attack with it; the blade is a finesse vibroweapon you're proficient with, dealing 1d6 kinetic damage.
  • Burst Core (requires a Blaster): the weapon gains the burst property, with a burst number equal to its reload number.
  • Booming Strikes (requires 5th level): once per turn on a hit you can add 1d6 damage, but the weapon lets out a boom audible 100 feet away; while hidden, Intelligence (Investigation) and Wisdom (Perception) checks to find you by sound then have advantage.
  • Celerity Oscillator: once per turn when your modified weapon damages a creature, your walking speed increases by 10 feet until the start of your next turn, and that creature can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of the turn.
  • Collapsible Frame (requires a Vibroweapon): an expandable hilt grants the weapon the reach property.
  • Compensation Oscillator (requires a Vibroweapon with the dexterity property): removes the dexterity property from the weapon.
  • Contoured Grip (requires 5th level and a Vibroweapon): +1 to attack rolls with the weapon, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Expanded Magazine (requires a Blaster): you can reload the weapon once without spending an action; you can't do so again until you reload it normally with an action.
  • Flashlight: as a bonus action you toggle an attached light; while lit, the weapon sheds bright light in a 60-foot cone.
  • Harpoon Reel: a secondary firemode launches a corded harpoon as a ranged attack (range 30/60) against a surface, object, or creature, dealing 1d6 kinetic damage on a hit. A struck creature is impaled and can spend its action making a Strength check to remove it; while lodged, a 60-foot cable connects you. As a bonus action you can reel it in — pulling yourself to the target if it's your size or larger, or pulling the target to you if it's smaller — or release the cable with no action. After use, it must be recovered and reloaded as an action before firing again.
  • Imbue Weapon (requires 9th level): over a short rest, you can cast an at-will tech power into the weapon as a stored charge; the next successful hit releases it, using a tech attack roll or forcing the normal saving throw as the power requires, and applying its usual effects on a hit or failed save.
  • Improved Burst Core (requires 9th level and Burst Core): the weapon's burst number drops to half its reload number.
  • Integrated Magazine (requires Expanded Magazine): you can reload the weapon twice without spending an action; you can't do so again until you reload it normally with an action.
  • Jagged Oscillator (requires a Vibroweapon): a critical hit deals an extra 1d8 kinetic damage.
  • Keen Oscillator (requires 5th level and Jagged Oscillator): the weapon's critical hit range widens by 1.
  • Neutronium Edge (requires 5th level and a Vibroweapon): +1 to damage rolls with the weapon, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Overcharge Weapon (requires 11th level and Booming Strikes): you can spend a tech slot to add extra damage of the weapon's damage type — 1d6 for a 1st-level slot, plus 1d6 per slot level above 1st, to a maximum of 5d6 — which stacks with the bonus damage of Booming Strikes if you use both on the same attack.
  • Power Loop (requires 9th level): on a hit you may convert the impact into temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt; usable once per long rest.
  • Recoil Dampener (requires a Blaster with the strength property): removes the strength property from the weapon.
  • Returning Weapon Guard (requires a Vibroweapon): a retractable chain grants the thrown property (range 20/60) if it lacks it already, plus the returning property.
  • Screening Weapon: a sound-dampening module gives Investigation and Perception checks that rely on sound disadvantage when trying to locate you while hidden and attacking with the weapon.
  • Shock Absorber: a reclamation module lets you cast absorb energy while wielding the weapon, and its extra damage now applies to both melee and ranged weapon attacks.
  • Siege Weapon: the weapon deals double damage against structures.
  • Shocking Harpoon (requires 9th level and Harpoon Reel): after hitting a creature with the harpoon firemode, you can use a bonus action to channel an at-will tech power through the connection at touch range, with advantage on the attack roll or the target's save made with disadvantage; usable again only after recovering the harpoon.
  • Shocking Oscillator (requires 9th level and a Vibroweapon): on a hit you may unleash an electric burst; each creature in a 15-foot cone centered on the target makes a Dexterity save, taking 1d8 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. Usable once per long rest.
  • Snap Fire (requires 9th level and a Blaster): you can use your reaction to make an opportunity attack with disadvantage when an enemy comes within 10 feet of you.
  • Staggering Oscillator (requires a Vibroweapon): on a hit, the target makes a Strength save or is pushed back 10 feet and knocked prone. Usable once per short or long rest.
  • Tracker (requires 5th level): a tracking module holds 3 charges; spend 1 as a bonus action to cast target lock, or 2 as an action to cast detect invisibility. All charges return after a long rest.
  • Truelight (requires 11th level and Flashlight): as a bonus action you activate a truesight mode on your flashlight for 1 minute, automatically dispelling illusions and detecting invisibility. Usable once per short or long rest.
  • Venomous Oscillator (requires 9th level and a Vibroweapon): as a bonus action you coat the weapon in poison for 1 minute; the next hit forces a Constitution save against your tech save DC, dealing 1d10 poison damage and inflicting the poisoned condition for 1 minute on a failure. Usable once per long rest.
